title: ObjectDB::slot_max accessed thread-unsafely
body:
### Tested versions

Tested 00a05128540016095a35eedef1a40069d50798c2 (built with use_tsan=yes)

### System information

Godot v4.5.beta (00a051285) - Debian GNU/Linux 13 (trixie) 13 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Single-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Mesa Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (RPL-P) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-1360P (16 threads) - 15.31 GiB memory

### Issue description

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/00a05128540016095a35eedef1a40069d50798c2/core/object/object.h#L1055

`slot_max` is normally protected by `spin_lock`, but it is accessed here before the lock is acquired. I don't believe this would cause any problems in practice due to 32-bit stores/loads being atomic on every platform I'm aware of (or at least the ones Godot runs on), but it does create a lot of extra noise when running with tsan.

I believe this could be fixed using `std::lock_guard<SpinLock>` to avoid having to do a lot of extra juggling to handle the early return within the ERR_FAIL_ macro. However, because I'm not completely sure and I don't know whether there's some lower level reason to avoid `std::lock_guard<SpinLock>`, I'm filing this as an issue rather than a pull request.

### Steps to reproduce

Compile Godot with `use_tsan=yes`
